headline: 本週影評：多部新片登場
context: 英國演員李察．E．格蘭特（Richard E Grant）主演的四集旅遊實境節目《現代奧德賽行》，評論形容比諾蘭的《奧德賽》電影更好看。記錄車臣戰爭下童年創傷的紀錄片《記憶》也拿下好評。諾蘭的《奧德賽》上映後，也帶動了原著小說在美國的買氣。

sources.name: The Guardian
sources.summary: The actor gobbles up food, roars with glee and finds himself deeply moved in this four-part travelogue inspired by the journey of Homer’s hero. It’s a real success of a show Here comes Richard E Grant, pounding towards us in his tiny leather jacket as he gesticulates wildly at his cobbled surrounds. “Wow,” he gasps. “Look at that.” We look at that. It’s Malta. Specifically, Malta’s Grand Harbour: a sobbingly beautiful gateway to the Mediterranean and the sun-blessed starting line for Richard E Grant’s Very Modern Odyssey, a four-part travelogue “inspired by Homer’s hero” in which the veteran actor traces Odysseus’s “incredible journey” while wearing a succession of increasingly voluminous linen trousers. Said tracing is not, however, an exact science. This is not one of those awful celebrity things in which our noble hero arms himself with set squares and a scholastic scowl before setting sail on a “voyage” to uncover “the truth”. sources.title: Richard E Grant’s Very Modern Odyssey review – far more thrilling than the Christopher Nolan borefest

sources.name: The Guardian
sources.summary: Vladlena Sandu’s extraordinary portrait of an upbringing during the 1990s Chechen wars blends surreal tableaux with flights of imagination to lament a collective loss of innocence Born in Feodosia, a Ukrainian city on the Crimean coast, Vladlena Sandu moved to her mother’s home town of Grozny in Chechnya when she was only six. Blue skies and cerulean waters dominated her childhood, but as the Chechen–Russian conflicts erupted into full-blown wars during the 1990s, she experienced terror, bloodshed, and death. Sandu pours these traumatic memories into her feature debut, a hybrid documentary portrait that doubles as cinematic exorcism, where the demons of the past are transformed into striking collages and vignettes. Across staged tableaux infused with theatrical flourishes and surreal abstraction, reality is superseded by childlike imagination. Adults are largely absent from the frame, although their harmful influences remain. A giant red cake painted with Lenin’s face conjures the ideological education Sandu received at school, while her grandfather, who would chase her with an axe when he was drunk, is represented as a pair of bloodied hands clasping a quivering baby chick. These images – both childlike and mythological – are accompanied by Sandu’s diaristic voiceover. Spoken in present tense, the events of the past acquire a stunning urgency. Continue reading...
sources.title: Memory review – a cinematic exorcism through a child’s eye view of terror in the Chechen wars

thread_text:
這週影評有得聊。李察．E．格蘭特主演的四集旅遊實境節目《現代奧德賽行》，評論說比諾蘭那部《奧德賽》電影更好看。記錄車臣戰爭下童年創傷的紀錄片《記憶》也拿下好評。另外，諾蘭的電影上映後，原著小說《奧德賽》在美國賣得更好了。

—— 本則來自 The Guardian，2026 年 8 月 3 日發佈，讓圖書館員翻譯給你聽。
threads_text:
這週的影評有不少話題。李察．E．格蘭特（Richard E Grant）主演的四集旅遊實境節目《現代奧德賽行》，追隨荷馬史詩裡奧德修斯的旅程路線拍攝，評論形容它比諾蘭那部《奧德賽》電影更好看、更有趣。另一部作品《記憶》，是記錄1990年代車臣戰爭下童年創傷的紀錄片，導演凡拉德蓮娜．桑杜（Vladlena Sandu）把自己的親身經歷拍成半紀錄半魔幻的影像。此外，大衛．林區的舊作《史崔特先生的故事》，也被影評人選為個人心目中的療癒電影；改編自兒童漫畫的《緞帶英雄》則評價普通。諾蘭執導的《奧德賽》電影上映後，也帶動了原著小說在美國書市的買氣。

本則來自 The Guardian，2026 年 8 月 3 日發佈的報導。
voice_text: 這週影評挺熱鬧。李察．E．格蘭特主演的旅遊實境節目《現代奧德賽行》，追著荷馬史詩裡奧德修斯的旅程走，評論說比諾蘭那部《奧德賽》電影還好看。另一部紀錄片《記憶》，講的是1990年代車臣戰爭下的童年創傷，導演把親身經歷拍成半紀錄半魔幻的影像。還有一部改編自兒童漫畫的電影，評價就普通了。倒是諾蘭的《奧德賽》上映後，原著小說在美國賣得更好了。
